intent.problem: After WI-18 closure, local post-close freeze and preflight passed, but the provider workflow checks an exact detached source checkout and cannot consume uncommitted local freeze evidence. Committing that evidence changes the source commit it records, creating a self-referential identity cycle.
constraints: Preserve committed-source preflight before runtime release projection.

intent.rationale: A controlled runtime freeze materialization removes the impossible post-merge self-reference while giving the provider a reproducible source-bound evidence set before publication.
